verdict.rationale: Manufact documents API keys for programmatic access to an organization from the REST API, CI pipelines, and scripts, so an agent can be given credentials. Nothing in the evidence shows those keys can be scoped or limited to least privilege, and the documented scope is org-wide access. missing for 10: per-key permission scopes or role restrictions, per-server or per-resource limits, expiry/rotation controls, agent-specific credential guidance, independent corroboration.
